# The tool query matrix: which command is run with which arguments, and the
# expected exit status. The recorded reference output of every case is in
# expected_tools/<case>.txt; see gen_tools_expected.sh for how the goldens are
# produced.
#
# Format (tab separated):
#   tool <TAB> case name <TAB> arguments <TAB> expected exit status
#
# The arguments are split on whitespace; paths are relative to the repository
# root. The case name is also the file name stem of the expected output, so it
# must match [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+.

# seinfo
seinfo	seinfo_stats	testdata/policies/sego_diff_a-v32.pol
seinfo	seinfo_all	testdata/policies/sego_test-v32.pol --all
seinfo	seinfo_all_expanded	testdata/policies/sego_test-v32.pol --all -x
seinfo	seinfo_components	testdata/policies/sego_diff_a-v32.pol -a -b -c -r -u --common --sensitivity --category --permissive --polcap --typebounds --constrain --validatetrans --default -x
seinfo	seinfo_labeling	testdata/policies/sego_diff_a-v32.pol --initialsid --fs_use --genfscon --portcon --netifcon --nodecon --ibpkeycon --ibendportcon -x
seinfo	seinfo_types	testdata/policies/sego_test-v32.pol -t
seinfo	seinfo_types_alias	-t app_alias -x testdata/policies/sego_test-v32.pol
seinfo	seinfo_types_filter	-t app_t -x testdata/policies/sego_test-v32.pol
seinfo	seinfo_role_types	testdata/policies/sego_test-v32.pol --role_types app_t
seinfo	seinfo_flat	testdata/policies/sego_test-v32.pol --flat -t
seinfo	seinfo_non_mls	policy/testdata/non_mls-v32.pol --all
seinfo	seinfo_xen	testdata/policies/sego_xen-v30.pol --all -x
seinfo	seinfo_xen_queries	testdata/policies/sego_xen-v30.pol --pirqcon 4 --ioportcon 0x0011 --pcidevicecon 0x0001 --iomemcon 0x0001 --devicetreecon /xen
seinfo	seinfo_portcon_error	testdata/policies/sego_test-v32.pol --portcon abc	2
seinfo	seinfo_xen_on_selinux	testdata/policies/sego_test-v32.pol --pirqcon 4	1

# sedta
